module: "Parking Spot Duplication Checker" debug tool for level designers: compares the parking spots (parkingSpots) of two .sites.json files (by default city.sites.json and facilities/delivery/mixed.sites.json of west_coast_usa) and lists those whose oriented boxes (OBB) overlap, drawing them in 3D with their name.
notes: Files A and B are chosen with editor_fileDialog (filter .sites.json).
The overlap test uses overlapsOBB_OBB on the pos/rot/scl of each parking spot.

compareFiles.desc: Loads the two sites files (gameplay_sites_sitesManager.loadSites) and fills the result list with each pair of parking spots whose OBBs overlap.

drawDebugMenu.desc: Draws the 'PS Duplication Checker' window: file selectors A/B, Compare button and the list of duplicates, drawn in 3D (orange for A, blue for B) with their name.

show.desc: Opens the tool: M.onUpdate = drawDebugMenu then extensions.hookUpdate('onUpdate').
